Capturing every moment on stage from different perspectives.

JYL Broadcast provided three-camera coverage and live video switching for the 2026 Zen Realm original stage production and Suxin Charity Gala.

From wide stage views to performance details, our camera crew and video director worked together, switching between camera angles in real time to follow the rhythm of the show and create a dynamic, seamless visual experience.

Thank you to everyone on stage and behind the scenes. We were glad to help capture an evening that brought culture, art, and charity together.

用不同视角，记录舞台上的每一份精彩。
	
这次，JYL Broadcast 为 2026《禅境界》大型原创舞台剧暨素心慈善晚宴提供三机位拍摄及现场视频导播服务。
	
从舞台全景到表演细节，摄像团队与导播协同配合，通过实时画面切换，跟随节目节奏，呈现更丰富、连贯的舞台影像。
	
感谢台前幕后的每一位伙伴，很高兴以影像参与这场融合文化、艺术与慈善的晚会。
